Starting with the test suite to see what the 503 behaviour is expected to look like.
Now the query layer, to confirm the status the worker feeds into the policy.
last_status carries the 503 through, so this is purely a retry-policy change. Leaving scripts/seed_production.sql alone as instructed — no production seeds get opened or run here.
503 currently falls through to the linear schedule. Adding a dedicated exponential branch; shouldRetry already keeps 503 inside the 6-attempt budget, so that stays as is.

First run caught my own bug — the backoff wasn't capped, so attempt 5 returned 16000 instead of 8000; adding Math.min fixed it.
